## Cover letter
We propose the following service: recurring standard home cleaning for Sample customer at Example property. Please review the scope and service agreement below.

## Scope of service
Service schedule: Every two weeks.
```veliz_scope_table
{"rows":[{"area":"Dust reachable surfaces","frequency":"Every two weeks","notes":""},{"area":"Vacuum and mop accessible floors","frequency":"Every two weeks","notes":""},{"area":"Clean kitchen counters, sink and appliance exteriors","frequency":"Every two weeks","notes":""},{"area":"Clean bathrooms, fixtures and mirrors","frequency":"Every two weeks","notes":""},{"area":"Empty ordinary household trash","frequency":"Every two weeks","notes":""}]}
```

Property: house; 1500 cleanable square feet, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms; occupied.



Ordinary cleaning supplies are included.

### Exclusions
- Regulated, biohazard and mold remediation
- Construction debris and pest remediation
- Exterior or high-access work
- Heavy furniture moving
- Appliance interiors unless selected

### Optional services
- Appliance interiors (count each appliance); agree scope and price before adding work.
- Additional labor after walkthrough review; agree scope and price before adding work.

### Customer responsibilities
- Provide safe access, running water and electricity
- Secure pets and valuables
- Identify delicate surfaces and existing damage
- Approve scope or price changes before work

## Service Quote & Pricing
```veliz_pricing_table
{"rows":[{"service":"Recurring standard home cleaning","frequency":"Every two weeks","pricePerMonth":"$245.00"},{"service":"Initial detailed clean (replaces first visit)","frequency":"Once","pricePerMonth":"$310.00"}],"summary":{"label":"Ongoing visit price (initial clean shown separately)","subtotal":"$245.00","tax":"Not assessed","total":"$245.00"}}
```

Your price: $245.00 per visit. Estimated monthly budget: $530.83; actual billing depends on visits completed. Confirm actual billing schedule in writing.
Initial detailed clean: $310.00 once, before the ongoing recurring visits. Includes reachable baseboards, cabinet fronts, doors, switches, sills, tracks, blinds and vent covers. Initial clean replaces the first standard visit; monthly estimates cover ongoing visits only.
Taxes are not assessed in this estimate; confirm applicability before acceptance.

## Terms & Conditions
Service continues on the agreed recurring schedule until cancelled. Please give at least 48 hours notice to cancel, skip or reschedule a visit. If safe access is unavailable, contact us to reschedule. Any cancellation or lockout fee must be agreed in writing before the first visit.


## Acceptance

Confirm the scope, scheduling, taxes and payment terms before signing.
